sheet.subject: Apollo Saturn V rocket
sheet.summary: Three-stage Apollo Saturn V with the Apollo spacecraft and launch escape tower, 110.6 m tall and 10.1 m in diameter.
sheet.proportions: About 11:1 height to diameter; the third stage narrows to about two thirds of the base diameter.
silhouette: Pointed tip formed by the escape tower
distinctive: Four fins and engine fairings at the base of the first stage
Black-and-white roll pattern on the first stage
Narrower third stage above a tapered interstage
Launch escape tower atop the conical command module

composition.evidence: Rocket only on a minimal base; Apollo stack with three stages and the escape tower.

review.summary: A slender three-stage stack in the right order with the spacecraft and escape tower. Roll pattern is simplified to full bands; fins are missing.

Three propulsion stages in order.evidence: S-IC, S-II and narrower S-IVB from the bottom (view 1).

Apollo spacecraft.evidence: Gray service module and conical command module.

Launch escape tower.evidence: Red truss and white motor at the tip.

Black and white roll markings.evidence: Full black bands instead of quadrant roll pattern.

improvements: S-IC: replace the full black bands with the quadrant roll pattern.
S-IC base: add four fins and engine fairings.
